verdict.rationale: PayPal offers REST APIs for products/pricing (subscriptions plans, invoicing), payment links, and an Agent Toolkit/MCP server enabling agent function-calling access to PayPal APIs, so an agent could plausibly chain these calls in one session. However there's no direct documentation of a single 'create product + price + payment link' workflow or evidence of the toolkit's specific function set covering product/price/payment-link creation end-to-end. missing for 10: explicit documentation or example of a single-session agent workflow creating a product, price, and payment link via the Agent Toolkit/MCP server; confirmation that these specific endpoints/functions are exposed to agents.
